title: Noise-Aware Differentially Private Variational Inference
abstract: arXiv:2410.19371v4 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Differential privacy (DP) provides robust privacy guarantees for statistical inference, but this can lead to unreliable results and biases in downstream applications. While several noise-aware approaches have been proposed which integrate DP perturbation into the inference, they are limited to specific types of simple probabilistic models. In this work, we propose a novel method for noise-aware approximate Bayesian inference based on stochastic gradient variational inference which can also be applied to high-dimensional and non-conjugate models. We also propose a more accurate evaluation method for noise-aware posteriors. Empirically, our inference method has similar performance to existing methods in the domain where they are applicable. Outside this domain, we obtain accurate coverages on high-dimensional Bayesian linear regression and well-calibrated predictive probabilities on Bayesian logistic regression with the UCI Adult

translated_title: 噪声感知的差分隐私变分推断
translated_abstract: 差分隐私（DP）为统计推断提供了强大的隐私保障，但这可能导致下游应用中出现不可靠的结果和偏差。虽然已有若干噪声感知方法被提出，可以将DP扰动整合到推断过程中，但这些方法仅限于特定类型的简单概率模型。在本工作中，我们提出了一种基于随机梯度变分推断的新型噪声感知近似贝叶斯推断方法，该方法还可应用于高维和非共轭模型。此外，我们还提出了一种更准确的噪声感知后验评估方法。实验表明，在现有方法适用的领域内，我们的推断方法具有与现有方法相似的性能。在此领域之外，我们在高维贝叶斯线性回归中获得了准确的覆盖率，并在使用UCI Adult数据集的贝叶斯逻辑回归中获得了良好校准的预测概率。
tldr: 提出了一种基于随机梯度变分推断的噪声感知差分隐私近似贝叶斯推断新方法，突破了以往方法仅适用于简单概率模型的局限，可应用于高维和非共轭模型，并提出了一种更准确的噪声感知后验评估方法。
en_tdlr: We propose a novel noise-aware differentially private approximate Bayesian inference method based on stochastic gradient variational inference, which extends beyond simple probabilistic models to high-dimensional and non-conjugate models, along with a more accurate evaluation method for noise-aware posteriors.
